title: Remove admin restriction on product uploads

requirements.text: Modify the backend authorization logic to allow any authenticated user (either via custom auth session or Internet Identity) to add products, removing the admin-only restriction

quotes: relax the guard to something like "any authenticated user can add products"

acceptanceCriteria: Any user with a valid session token can successfully call addProduct
Any user authenticated via Internet Identity can successfully call addProduct
The 'Authorization Error: Unauthorized: Only admins can add products' error no longer appears for authenticated users
Unauthenticated users still cannot add products

requirements.text: Update the frontend ProductManagement component to remove or adjust any client-side admin checks that might be preventing product uploads for authenticated non-admin users
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can access the product upload form
Product upload dialog opens successfully for any authenticated user
No client-side validation blocks authenticated users from submitting products

constraints: Maintain authentication requirement - unauthenticated users should still not be able to add products
Preserve existing product data structure and storage mechanisms
nonGoals: Modifying product data schema or fields
Implementing granular role-based permissions beyond authenticated/unauthenticated
